change: Enable existing FP8 prefill page-LSE reuse for the Blackwell device tier in the default compatibility build.
supported_target: CUDA 13.1 or newer, sm_120a; RTX 5090 and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell share this route.
hardware_validation: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition. RTX 5090 was not separately tested.
admission: Single GPU, FP8 KV, D256, 24 query heads, 4 KV heads, prefill width >64, existing sampled-row/capacity guards; unsupported cases retain independent statistics.

kernel_comparison.scope: Production FP8 attention plus page statistics only; independent FP64 oracle. Default compatibility attention compiled natively for sm_120a; widened-KV route disabled.
kernel_comparison.timing_method: CUDA event medians of 10 measured calls after 2 warmups; separate/reuse/separate order.

end_to_end_comparison.model: Qwen3.8-27B NVIDIA NVFP4, same frozen-tokenizer .ninfer artifact used in the RTX 4090 RULER tests
end_to_end_comparison.intervention: Only NINFER_PREFILL_PAGE_LSE_REUSE changes: 0 for independent statistics, 1 for fused statistics. Same binary and arguments, except output log location.
end_to_end_comparison.timing_method: Client elapsed time from sending a raw-token HTTP request to its single-token completion event. Model loading, warmup, compilation and model transfer excluded; host processing, KV transfers and one generated token included. Throughput is input length divided by mean elapsed time.
end_to_end_comparison.order: Separate before (2 measured requests per size), reuse (3 per size), separate after (1 per size). Each server first warms up with 1024 and 98304 tokens.
end_to_end_comparison.harness_repair: The port-availability probe initially lacked SO_REUSEADDR and rejected TIME_WAIT at the first server transition, before any reuse requests ran. Fixed the probe and resumed, preserving the completed baseline; no model-inference failure or discarded measured request.
end_to_end_comparison.coverage: Single request on this model, one frozen input at two prefix lengths. This does not measure full 261737-token input, decode, concurrent serving, or 130-case RULER accuracy. Page probability accumulation is still subject to the separately documented rounding differences.
end_to_end_comparison.measurement_context: Both measured arms used the same experimental build with the separate MTP resident-pressure change enabled. That change is held constant, is not required by page-LSE reuse, and is not included in this PR. The reported absolute rates describe that measured configuration.

limitations: Page probabilities differ from separate FP32 QK accumulation within the measured FP64 tolerance; main attention output was bit-identical in the four tested kernel cases.
No local 130-case RULER accuracy rerun, full 261737-token input, decode or concurrency measurement.
Full-model measurements predate the independent history-ownership fix now in the PR base; the changed kernel and oracle sources are identical.
